name.zh: 真掌鳍鱼 Eusthenopteron foordi（小型个体）

scope: Original whole living fish based on articulated small E.foordi specimens; not an amphibian walking pose or generic coelacanth recolor.

taxon.context: Late Devonian Miguasha, Quebec; aquatic reconstruction, not direct-ancestor certainty or terrestrial locomotion claim.
anchors: MHNM06-1754 and MHNM06-1769 in Charest et al2023 Figs10–11
MHNM06-59 caudal region in Leblanc2005 Fig6

scale.basis: Artist nominal small individual, near primary small-specimen size class; NOT giant adult dimensions or exact same-specimen measurements. Whole living thickness and fin stance are inferred. Report actual bounds.

pose: Neutral fully aquatic horizontal swim; head closed mouth; pectoral/pelvic fins slightly spread with fleshy bases connected to body, no supporting feet or terrain.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 4–6 subdued gray/olive/slate/tan palette values, not fossil pigment claim. No emissive eyes.
surface_profile.detail: Closed thin-solid fins, single-sided materials; no paper-thin DoubleSide planes. Selective facet/scale structure, no thousands of separate scales or detached bead objects.

coordinates.origin: Model centerline projected to lowest-body reference plane at Z0; neutral unsupported swimming pose, no stand. State exact bounds.

view_plan.source: Exact final GLB clean-import, fixed numeric camera/light/color template and hash-bound manifest.
view_plan.greybox: Inspect silhouette/body thickness and all fin placements before detail.
view_plan.extra_views: Only targeted diagnostic for concrete ambiguity; no mandatory8 views in current scoped making.

scientific_limits: Primary illustrated specimens include small individuals; this asset is explicitly small-bodied, not an adult giant scaled from a juvenile skull.
Fossil flattening and internal skeleton do not establish exact skin thickness, live cross-section or pigmentation. Muted original colors and lowpoly flesh volumes are artwork.
Fin-ray skeleton can guide outline but is not exposed externally; living fins have continuous opaque thin-solid webs with few stylized radial ridges.
No digits, toes, walking elbows or terrestrial support pose. Lobe-fin anatomy is not proof of walking or direct human ancestry.
Caudal contour is a single integrated fin with upper/lower lobes and axial terminal region, not three separate tail fins; terminal shape softly simplified within inspected evidence.
Closed mouth avoids inventing exact tooth display. Head-roof/opercular seams understated, no osteological holes or huge external nostrils.

morphology.obligation: Elongate fish body, broad moderately flattened elongated head with a rounded snout and two modest dorsolateral eyes; body tapers toward tail. Cohesive gill cover/cheek volume, no neck or primitive bead junctions.
morphology.source: Charest et al2023 Figs10–11 actual small whole fossils; soft volumes interpretive.

morphology.obligation: Two paired pectoral and two paired pelvic fins. Each has a fleshy lobe-like base flowing into fan-shaped ray-bearing fin; pelvic pair distinctly farther back. No fingers or separate terrestrial limbs.
morphology.source: Actual whole specimens Figs10–11 and Leblanc2005 fin study.

morphology.obligation: Exactly two separated dorsal fins plus one anal fin. First dorsal near mid-trunk; second farther posterior and approximately paired in position/shape with anal below. Second dorsal and anal narrow-based, posteriorly pointed; no continuous eel dorsal ribbon or huge sail.
morphology.source: Charest et al2023 text E.foordi, actual Figs10–11.

morphology.obligation: One broad integrated caudal fin with upper and lower ray fields and subtle central/axial termination; continuous peduncle. Preserve separation from second dorsal and anal; no shark scythe or tuna V-tail.
morphology.source: Leblanc2005 Fig6 MHNM06-59 actual caudal structure drawing; CharestFig11 fossil.

morphology.obligation: Restrained close-packed scale/facet suggestion, not giant blocky armored tiles. Fin-base flesh and fine ray-fan surfaces should remain distinct.
morphology.source: Visible specimen scales and fin regions; texture density/colors artist choices.

acceptance_obligations: Four exactGLB front/side/top/perspective; side confirms2dorsals+anal and one integrated caudal; top/front confirms both paired fin sets, broad head and finite body thickness; perspective confirms fleshy bases, no disconnected fans or walking limbs.
Count8 fins:2pectoral+2pelvic+2dorsal+1anal+1caudal. Left/right counterparts must exist even if occluded in side. Targeted underside view only if needed.
Species silhouette combines elongated head, fleshy paired fins and2dorsal+anal arrangement, not generic trout or coelacanth reused geometry. Small individual scope must remain in metadata.
Single-sided closed thin-solid fins, no DoubleSide rescue. Two complete deterministic factory builds with semantic digests; default helper; exactGLB/native/export/validator reports.
Independent morphology QA; full production8/GPU/scene/user acceptance not claimed.
production_boundary: Full static-stylized-v1 production8/GPU/scene contract is retained as reference but NOT claimed passed or imposed as current maker scope; user-requested4view model acceptance is separate.
